name: web-monochrome-crm-dashboard-with-hatched-bar-chart-and-black-actions
title: Monochrome CRM Dashboard with Hatched Bars
whatItIs: A cream and white CRM dashboard on a grey backdrop with a sidebar, a lead preview table, notifications, a bar chart of rounded hatched bars with one solid black bar and a tooltip, a lesson sections list and a pro upsell card, with black buttons for actions.
whatItMeans: Hatched bars and black buttons give a crisp, editorial look, and a single solid bar shows the selection.
techniques: Rounded hatched bars as chart texture
One solid black bar as the selected value
Black pill buttons as the only strong contrast
Cursor and name tag showing collaboration
Warm cream panels on a light shell

vocabulary.definition: A bar filled with fine lines instead of solid colour.
A floating card showing details of a hovered value.
A sidebar card promoting a paid plan.
